description: Bell-pull: a thick three-strand twisted rope, 1.75 m, hanging from a small brass ceiling plate and ring, ending in a knotted tassel of loose cords; faded hemp/cream with dirt where handled. Hangs straight: its top (the plate) is the top of the bounds and goes against the ceiling; the bounds' floor point is the tassel's lowest strand (origin is there, not at the top).

paint.prompt: thick twisted hemp bell-pull rope with a knotted tassel, faded cream, grubby where pulled
